A timeless children's song among the humans tells how it made powerful mice companions and legions of war mice. Then it declared war on all humankind. He comes home after a long campaign to find his young son kidnapped by the Magic Mouse, and his son's pet kitten Toraji transformed into a half-human cat mix. synopsis: When her mother marries into high society, Lilisa Suzunomiya is forced to leave her commoner ways behind. Now enrolled at an elite all-girls academy, she’s expected to smile politely, sip tea, and hang up her beloved guitar for (ugh…) a violin. But when she hears drums echoing from the old school building, Lilisa is dragged into a jam session with the secretly rebellious young lady Otoha Kurogane, and her passion for music is reignited! High society better watch out—the academy’s most demure maidens are teaming up to form an elegant rock band the likes of which the world has never seen! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Changsheng Zhi Nüjiang Xing
synopsis: General Heyan met her end through betrayal, only to be reborn as a frail maiden. Vowing to reclaim all she lost, she returned to the barracks and took up arms once more under a new identity, determined to earn a marquis title and strike fear into the Nine Provinces. Along the way, she reunited with her formidable foe from a past life—a wolfish young general. Hand in hand, they marched onto the battlefield together, forging the legend of the Twin Generals. Amidst tangled threads of love and hate, and the treacherous web of power struggles, witness how this woman of valor earns her marquis title and strikes fear into the hearts of all under heaven. (Source: Tencent, translated)
